text_block_list.text:
One day.
I was invited to a private training camp
wrap-up party at a reserved venue,
finding myself completely surrounded by a
cadre of veteran Trainers—
choice_data_list: T-Thank you very much for inviting...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Are you nervous? Haha,
you really wear it on your face,
don't you? Don't look so tense,
we didn't corner you to scold you or
anything.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
That's right~ We just wanted to have a chat.
About that girl you've been keeping an eye on—
Believe, to be specific.
choice_data_list: Huh...? Did something happen with her?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
...To put it bluntly.
Would you be willing to take a look at
Believe?
choice_data_list: Wait, me—?!
Wait, me—?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san.
Looking forward to working with you on this
provisional contract.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I have completed warm-ups.
Please instruct today's menu.
choice_data_list: A-Ah, sure! Well, before that—
Y-Yeah! Well, before that—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list: What kind of runner do you want to...
What kind of runner do you want to...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I want to become fast.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I want to be fast. ...Above all else.

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list: ...Got it! Then, let's get started.

text_block_list.text:
Even as I replied...
feeling a sense of 'just as expected,' I
recalled what the veteran Trainers had told
me the other day.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
The truth is,
each of us entered into a provisional contract
with her once before. But somehow...
none of us could guide her properly.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
...Her training ethic is beyond reproach.
You saw it for yourself at the camp,
didn't you?
A girl with that kind of single-minded
devotion is a rare find.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It's just,
she might be a little *too* single-minded,
or rather... how to put it.
...She never voices an opinion,
let alone a complaint.
She stays completely silent on that front.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"To us,
her running form seemed reminiscent of
runners like Bubble Gum Fellow,
who excelled in classic middle-distance turf
races."

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"So we set up mock races around the longer
1,600m to 1,800m range to train her...
but the results were underwhelming."

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, from there,
you'd compare notes with the runner's own
instincts to figure out their aptitude,
but—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah, haah...! 
...—gh!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...My apologies.
I placed 8th in the mock race.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry! Was 1,800m too long?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Running is my job.
Therefore,
the poor execution is my responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I will hone my craft further.
Please allow me to increase my independent
training volume.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I must become fast. Faster, and faster—

...It was exactly as they said.
Flawless dedication. Yet on the other hand,
lackluster results. And—
choice_data_list: (She shoulders everything... entir...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
None of us were able to draw out her true
feelings.
Honestly, that's frustrating. ...However,
far more than that.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
We refuse to let the raw talent we all fell
in love with be buried away.
That's why we're talking to you now.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
What do you say?
Would you let us entrust her to you?
You're curious about Believe too,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Right now, you're the one drawn to her,
so there are things only you can do.
...Can we count on you?
Promising rookie Trainer.

—Today as well,
Believe continues to train with utter devotion
exactly according to my instructions.
Watching her, I reflect.
choice_data_list: (What I can do for this girl—!)
(What I can do for this girl—!)

text_block_list.text:
Naturally,
the veteran Trainers are superior when it
comes to technical expertise. So that isn't it.
What I can do as a rookie Trainer—yes,
for instance.

Because I'm a complete novice who isn't
managing a massive team and can start from
a purely one-on-one dynamic—
what only I can do—
choice_data_list: (Is to face her with everything I ...
(I need to face her with everythin...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: My next day off...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I was thinking of going for a walk.
...Why do you ask?
choice_data_list: Would it be alright if I tagged along?
Would it be alright if I tagged along?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: If it's a bother, feel free to tur...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that it's a bother...
......

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I just don't understand.
What for?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I mean—it's your day off too, isn't it?
choice_data_list: I want to talk with you more.
I want to talk with you more.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Well...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It probably... won't be very fun.
